🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* United States (US Senate, President Donald Trump, White House, USTR)
• *Announcement:* The US Senate has passed a bill authorizing up to 100\% tariffs on countries, including India, for significant purchases of Russian energy, a measure supported by President Trump\. Additionally, a new White House report accuses India of enabling China to evade US tariffs through transshipment, while the USTR has also imposed a 10\% tariff over forced labor concerns\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(90\% \- The US Senate has passed legislation authorizing up to 100\% tariffs, strongly supported by President Trump, indicating a near\-finalized policy direction for severe trade penalties, compounded by active USTR tariffs and investigations\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Metals/Auto, Chemicals, Pharma, EMS
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(The potential imposition of 100\% tariffs, coupled with existing tariffs and allegations of tariff evasion, creates extreme uncertainty and significantly escalates trade tensions, leading to a strong risk\-off sentiment and pressure on the Indian rupee and export\-oriented sectors\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Indian fund managers should immediately de\-risk portfolios by significantly reducing exposure to export\-oriented sectors with high US market dependency, particularly those implicated in potential 100\% tariffs or transshipment allegations, and prioritize defensive, domestic\-consumption\-focused stocks\.
